title: Interview Ready
tagline: Coding, systems, quant and behavioural interviews
description: A university-grade preparation course that trains a method, not memorised answers: the six moves, a bottleneck → technique table, invariants and exchange arguments, applied to hundreds of problems you solve in Python or C++ against hidden tests, plus systems, quant and behavioural tracks.
